channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Man arrested in Osaka for alleged abuse and murder of daughter
item.description: According to an expert committee, 50 children died from physical abuse or neglect in Japan in fiscal 2024.

item.title: Japan’s biggest banks raise profit targets, announce buybacks
item.description: Cashing in on rising interest rates and robust loan demand has put banks on course for another record year.

item.title: Japan’s economy shrinks as bad weather weighs on consumption
item.description: Rising living costs have also continued to make consumers cautious, with pensioners in particular becoming ever more thrifty, the BOJ said.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
